annotations.exact_quote: Multi-label learning deals with training examples each represented by a single instance while associated with multiple class labels.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将多标记学习作为研究任务，说明每个实例可关联多个类别标记。

annotations.exact_quote: class-imbalance stands as an intrinsic property of multi-label data which significantly affects the generalization performance of the multi-label predictive model
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要将类别不平衡作为多标记数据的内在属性，并围绕正负样本数量不均衡提出处理策略。

annotations.exact_quote: leveraging the exploitation of label correlations as well as the exploration of class-imbalance simultaneously
annotations.reason_zh: COCOA 明确利用标签相关性，说明方法显式建模并利用标签间依赖关系。

annotations.exact_quote: a number of multiclass imbalance learners are induced by randomly coupling with other labels, whose predictions on the unseen instance are aggregated to determine the corresponding labeling relevancy
annotations.reason_zh: 对每个标签诱导多个多分类不平衡学习器，并聚合未见实例上的预测以确定标签相关性，符合分类器集成。
